api.error.network.defaultMessage: サーバーに接続できませんでした。接続を確かめて、もう一度試してください。
api.error.network.description: Error message when a request to the server got no answer (offline, or the server is down).

api.error.status.defaultMessage: サーバーが要求を処理できませんでした（エラー {status}）。しばらくしてから試してください。
api.error.status.description: Error message when the server failed without describing the problem. {status} is the HTTP status code, for example 502.

home.title.description: Heading and document title of the home timeline page.

local.title.defaultMessage: ローカルタイムライン
local.title.description: Heading and document title of the page with the public posts of this server's accounts.

login.body.defaultMessage: {instance} にログインすると、投稿したり、ほかの人をフォローしたり、ホームタイムラインを読んだりできます。
login.body.description: Text on the sign-in page. {instance} is the name of this server.

login.failed.denied.defaultMessage: サーバーの画面でログインが取り消されました。
login.failed.denied.description: Why signing in failed: the user declined on the server's authorization screen.

login.failed.invalid_state.defaultMessage: このログインはこのタブで始めたものではないか、すでに完了しています。もう一度始めてください。
login.failed.invalid_state.description: Why signing in failed: the answer from the server does not belong to a sign-in that this browser tab started.

login.failed.rejected.defaultMessage: サーバーがログインを受け付けませんでした。もう一度始めてください。
login.failed.rejected.description: Why signing in failed: the server refused to finish it (for example, it took too long).

login.failed.retry.defaultMessage: もう一度ログインする
login.failed.retry.description: Link from the failed sign-in page back to the sign-in page.

login.failed.title.defaultMessage: ログインできませんでした
login.failed.title.description: Heading and document title of the page shown when signing in failed on the way back from the server's sign-in screen.

login.submit.description: Button on the sign-in page that opens the server's sign-in screen.

login.title.description: Heading and document title of the page that starts signing in.

notifications.empty.all.defaultMessage: まだ通知はありません
notifications.empty.all.description: Heading shown on the notifications page when the user has no notifications.

notifications.empty.description.defaultMessage: フォローされたり、メンションされたり、投稿に反応があったりすると、ここに表示されます。
notifications.empty.description.description: Text under the heading of an empty notifications page.

notifications.empty.filtered.defaultMessage: この種類の通知はありません
notifications.empty.filtered.description: Heading shown on the notifications page when no notification matches the selected type filter.

notifications.filter.all.description: Tab on the notifications page that shows notifications of every type.

notifications.filter.boosts.description: Tab on the notifications page that shows only boosts of the user's posts.

notifications.filter.favourites.description: Tab on the notifications page that shows only favourites of the user's posts.

notifications.filter.follows.description: Tab on the notifications page that shows only new followers, follow requests and accepted follow requests.

notifications.filter.label.description: Accessible name of the tab list that filters the notifications by type.

notifications.filter.mentions.description: Tab on the notifications page that shows only posts that mention the user.

notifications.load_more.defaultMessage: さらに通知を読み込む
notifications.load_more.description: Button at the end of the notifications that loads older ones.

notifications.loading.description: Accessible name of the progress indicator while notifications load.

notifications.post.error.defaultMessage: この投稿を読み込めませんでした。
notifications.post.error.description: Shown in a notification in place of the post it is about, when the post could not be loaded.

notifications.post.open.description: Link in a notification that opens the post it is about.

notifications.post.show.description: Button that shows a post hidden behind its author's content warning, in a notification.

notifications.retry.description: Button that loads the notifications again after they failed to load.

notifications.sign_in.description: Link on the notifications page, when nobody is signed in, that opens the sign-in page.

notifications.signed_out.defaultMessage: 通知を見るにはログインしてください。
notifications.signed_out.description: Text on the notifications page when nobody is signed in.

notifications.time.description: When a notification happened: its date and time, for example 'Oct 16, 2026 9:41 AM'. {time} is that moment.

notifications.title.description: Heading and document title of the notifications page.

notifications.type.boost.defaultMessage: {name}さんがあなたの投稿をブーストしました
notifications.type.boost.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the account that boosted the user's post.

notifications.type.favourite.defaultMessage: {name}さんがあなたの投稿をお気に入りに登録しました
notifications.type.favourite.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the account that favourited the user's post.

notifications.type.follow.defaultMessage: {name}さんにフォローされました
notifications.type.follow.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the new follower.

notifications.type.follow_accepted.defaultMessage: {name}さんがフォローリクエストを承認しました
notifications.type.follow_accepted.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the account that accepted the user's follow request.

notifications.type.follow_request.defaultMessage: {name}さんからフォローリクエストが届きました
notifications.type.follow_request.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the account that asked to follow the user.

notifications.type.mention.defaultMessage: {name}さんがあなたをメンションしました
notifications.type.mention.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the author of a post that mentions the user.

notifications.type.moderation_notice.defaultMessage: このサーバーのモデレーターからお知らせが届きました
notifications.type.moderation_notice.description: Notification sentence: a notice to the user from the moderators of the server.

notifications.type.poll_closed.defaultMessage: 参加した投票が終了しました
notifications.type.poll_closed.description: Notification sentence: a poll that the user created or voted in has closed.

notifications.unread.description: Read by screen readers before the sentence of a notification that was new when the page opened.

notifications.unread_count.description: The number of unread notifications on the badge of the navigation item, for example '3 unread'.

page.not_built.defaultMessage: この画面はまだ準備中です。
page.not_built.description: Text below the heading of a page whose screen the web client does not have yet.

profile.title.description: Heading and document title of the signed-in user's own profile page.

session.account.title.description: Heading of the section of the settings page about the signed-in account.

session.sign_in.description: Link in the account section of the settings page that opens the sign-in page.

session.sign_out.description: Button that signs the user out of the app in every tab.

session.sign_out.failed.defaultMessage: この画面からはログアウトしましたが、サーバーに接続できませんでした。ページを再読み込みするとログインした状態に戻ることがあります。
session.sign_out.failed.description: Notice after signing out when the server could not be told; the browser may still hold the session.

session.signed_out.defaultMessage: ログインしていません。
session.signed_out.description: Text in the account section of the settings page when nobody is signed in.

settings.title.description: Heading and document title of the settings page.

shell.about.domain.defaultMessage: このサーバーのアカウントは @{domain} で終わります。
shell.about.domain.description: In the side column about this server: the domain of the handles of local accounts, for example 'Accounts here end with @example.com.'.

shell.about.title.defaultMessage: このサーバーについて
shell.about.title.description: Heading of the side column, shown on wide screens, that tells about the server the user is on.

shell.document_title.description: The browser tab title: the heading of the current page, then the server's name.

shell.error.body.defaultMessage: このページを表示できませんでした。もう一度試すか、しばらくしてから開いてください。
shell.error.body.description: Text on the page shown when a screen failed to load or broke.

shell.error.retry.description: Button that loads the failed page again.

shell.error.title.description: Heading of the page shown when a screen failed to load or broke.

shell.loading.description: Accessible name of the progress indicator shown while a page loads.

shell.nav.home.description: Navigation item that opens the home timeline. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bottom tab bar.

shell.nav.label.description: Accessible name of the main navigation (the tab bar on phones, the side rail on larger screens).

shell.nav.local.description: Navigation item that opens the local timeline (posts of this server's accounts). Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bottom tab bar.

shell.nav.notifications.description: Navigation item that opens the notifications. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bottom tab bar.

shell.nav.notifications_unread.defaultMessage: 通知、{count, plural, other {未読 # 件}}
shell.nav.notifications_unread.description: Accessible name of the navigation item that opens the notifications while some are unread. Start it with the text of shell.nav.notifications, which is shown. {count} is the number of unread notifications.

shell.nav.profile.description: Navigation item that opens the user's own profile. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bottom tab bar.

shell.nav.settings.description: Navigation item that opens the settings. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bottom tab bar.

shell.not_found.body.defaultMessage: このアドレスのページはありません。
shell.not_found.body.description: Text on the page shown for an address that the web client has no page for.

shell.not_found.home.defaultMessage: ホームタイムラインへ
shell.not_found.home.description: Link on the not-found page back to the home timeline.

shell.not_found.title.defaultMessage: ページが見つかりません
shell.not_found.title.description: Heading of the page shown for an address that the web client has no page for.

shell.skip_to_main.description: Link at the very start of every page, visible when focused, that moves keyboard focus past the navigation.

shell.startup_error.body.defaultMessage: サーバーから届いた設定をアプリが読み取れませんでした。ページを再読み込みしてください。繰り返し起きる場合は、サーバーの管理者に知らせてください。
shell.startup_error.body.description: Text shown instead of the app when its runtime configuration from the server is missing or invalid.

shell.startup_error.title.defaultMessage: アプリを起動できませんでした
shell.startup_error.title.description: Heading shown instead of the app when its runtime configuration from the server is missing or invalid.

shell.toast.dismiss.description: Accessible name of the × button that closes a toast message.

shell.toast.region.description: Accessible name of the area where short status messages (toasts) appear, such as 'Post published'.

shell.update.apply.description: Button in the message about a new version of the app; pressing it reloads the page into the new version.

shell.update.available.defaultMessage: アプリの新しい版があります。
shell.update.available.description: Message shown when a new version of the web app has been downloaded and waits until the user applies it.

tag.title.description: Heading and document title of the page with the posts of one hashtag. {tag} is the hashtag without the #, for example 'cats'.

timeline.boosted_by.description: Line above a post in a timeline that someone else shared (boosted). {name} is the display name of the account that boosted it.

timeline.content_warning.toggle.description: Button next to a post's content warning that shows or hides the post behind it. The same text is used while the post is shown.

timeline.empty.home.action.defaultMessage: ローカルタイムラインを見る
timeline.empty.home.action.description: Link from the empty home timeline to the local timeline, where the user can find people to follow.

timeline.empty.home.description.defaultMessage: 自分の投稿と、フォローしている人の投稿がここに表示されます。
timeline.empty.home.description.description: Text under the heading of the empty home timeline.

timeline.empty.home.heading.defaultMessage: ホームタイムラインに投稿はありません
timeline.empty.home.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when the home timeline has none.

timeline.empty.local.description.defaultMessage: このサーバーの人の公開投稿がここに表示されます。
timeline.empty.local.description.description: Text under the heading of the empty local timeline.

timeline.empty.local.heading.defaultMessage: まだ投稿はありません
timeline.empty.local.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when the local timeline has none.

timeline.empty.tag.description.defaultMessage: #{tag} の付いた公開投稿がここに表示されます。
timeline.empty.tag.description.description: Text under the heading of an empty hashtag timeline. {tag} is the hashtag without the #.

timeline.empty.tag.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when no post has the hashtag. {tag} is the hashtag without the #.

timeline.keyboard_hint.defaultMessage: タイムラインでは Page Down と Page Up で投稿の間を移動できます。
timeline.keyboard_hint.description: Hint for screen reader users before a timeline, about the keys that move from post to post.

timeline.load_more.description: Button at the end of a timeline that loads older posts.

timeline.load_more.failed.defaultMessage: 投稿を読み込めませんでした: {reason}
timeline.load_more.failed.description: Message, read out and shown at the end of a timeline, when older posts failed to load. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

timeline.loading.description: Accessible name of the progress indicator while posts of a timeline load.

timeline.media.no_description.description: Badge on a picture of a post whose author gave no description (alternative text); screen readers read it as the picture's name.

timeline.media.reveal.defaultMessage: センシティブなメディアを表示
timeline.media.reveal.description: Toggle button over the pictures of a post that the author marked sensitive; it shows or hides them.

timeline.retry.description: Button at the end of a timeline that tries again to load older posts after a failure.

timeline.signed_out.action.description: Link on the home page, when nobody is signed in, that opens the sign-in page.

timeline.signed_out.description.defaultMessage: ログインすると、フォローしている人の投稿を読めます。
timeline.signed_out.description.description: Text on the home page when nobody is signed in.

timeline.signed_out.heading.defaultMessage: ログインしていません
timeline.signed_out.heading.description: Heading on the home page when nobody is signed in, shown instead of the home timeline.
